items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: And the only reason that Dave Bithalemus said this, Joe Dave Bithalemus said, man, that's a hell of a record you got there.

ctx.x: And the only reason that Dave Bithalemus said this, Joe Dave Bithalemus said, man, that's a hell of a record you got there. He said, but I bet you one thing. And this is me. He said, I bet you ain't gonna do nothing because London is not gonna promote. Yeah.
